title: Wednesday
summary: A day whose spelling keeps a clue that its modern sound almost hides.
question: Where did Wednesday get its name?
completion: Wednesday keeps Woden’s name. Woden and Norse Odin are corresponding god names; the Roman calendar used Mercury here. German Mittwoch names the same day using a middle-of-the-week idea.
partner: A similar sound is a clue. Let’s check the evidence.
